_about: The places of 豫 — 定陶 alone for now, by the 菏泽 (导菏泽, the 禹贡's 豫州). No chapter opens 豫 yet, so its roads stay closed; it joins the world when its chapter is written.

line.zh: 天下之中的商城。陶朱公在这儿三聚三散。
line.en: The merchant city at the centre of the world. Here Lord Tao made three fortunes and gave three away.
